findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name File operations in filelock
 * @description Find file operations in the filelock package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/file-operations
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "fdopen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall()
select call, "File operation found"

/**
 * @name Potential symlink attack vulnerability
 * @description File open operations without O_NOFOLLOW could be vulnerable to symlink attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/symlink-attack
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-059
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Find os.open calls
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall()
  or
  // Find built-in open() calls
  call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
select call, "File open operation that may follow symbolic links without O_NOFOLLOW protection"
findings.hypothesis: File open operations without O_NOFOLLOW could be vulnerable to symlink attacks

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Time-of-check-time-of-use race condition in filelock
 * @description TOCTOU vulnerability where file existence is checked before opening
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/toctou-race-condition
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode checkCall, DataFlow::CallCfgNode openCall
where
  // File existence check
  checkCall = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["path", "exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
  checkCall = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember(["Path", "exists"]).getACall()
  and
  // File open operation
  (openCall = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or
   openCall = API::builtin("open").getACall())
  and
  // Same file path argument (simple check - same string literal)
  checkCall.getArg(0).toString() = openCall.getArg(0).toString()
select openCall, "Possible TOCTOU race condition: file existence check followed by file open"
findings.hypothesis: Time-of-check-time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in file lock operations
